planSteps.description: Submit this chat prompt: "Design a 500 x 400 cm office with a desk near the north wall, office chair, bookcase, shelf, rug, and plant."
Wait until a layout appears in the canvas.
Submit this follow-up prompt: "Move the bookcase to the west wall and add a second plant, but keep the desk and chair."
Wait until the updated response finishes.
The canvas still shows a floor-plan surface rather than the empty state.
The rendered layout still includes desk and office chair text or labels after the revision.
